title: 语法 · 否定与情态｜范围和语气 · 60 句
description: 部分与全否定、否定转移、不必与禁止、建议责任、推断和弱否定；不以完成时态为专题。

items.zh: 不是所有座位都能看见字幕。
items.en: Not all seats offer a view of the subtitles.
answers: Not all seats offer a view of the subtitles.
items.notes: not all 表部分否定，不等于 no seats。

items.zh: 我并不总是选择最便宜的餐点。
items.en: I do not always choose the cheapest meal.
answers: I do not always choose the cheapest meal.
I don't always choose the cheapest meal.
items.notes: not always：不总是，不是 never。

items.zh: 这两条路线都不经过海滩。
items.en: Neither route passes the beach.
answers: Neither route passes the beach.
items.notes: neither 指两者都不；谓语用单数 passes。

items.zh: 这里没有一位客人预订过早餐。
items.en: None of the guests booked breakfast.
answers: None of the guests booked breakfast.
items.notes: none of 表已限定群体中没有任何一个。

items.zh: 这些照片并非都在同一天拍摄。
items.en: The photographs were not all taken on the same day.
answers: The photographs were not all taken on the same day.
The photographs weren't all taken on the same day.
items.notes: not all 限定整组不是全部同日，不表示任意两张日期都不同。

items.zh: 她的意见并不完全基于个人经历。
items.en: Her view is not based entirely on personal experience.
answers: Her view is not based entirely on personal experience.
Her view isn't based entirely on personal experience.
items.notes: not ... entirely 表并非完全，不否认部分依据。

items.zh: 我从没说过这个安排适合每个人。
items.en: I never said the arrangement suited everyone.
answers: I never said the arrangement suited everyone.
items.notes: never 否定说过这一行为，不直接断言安排不适合任何人。

items.zh: 两个候选人中，没有一个愿意提前开始。
items.en: Neither of the candidates is willing to start early.
answers: Neither of the candidates is willing to start early.
items.notes: neither of + 复数群体，书面语谓语用单数。

items.zh: 没有任何一种调味料能弥补食材不新鲜的问题。
items.en: No seasoning can compensate for stale ingredients.
answers: No seasoning can compensate for stale ingredients.
items.notes: no + 名词表示全否定；can 表能力范围。

items.zh: 这家店并非每逢节假日都关门。
items.en: The shop does not close on every public holiday.
answers: The shop does not close on every public holiday.
The shop doesn't close on every public holiday.
items.notes: not ... every 表部分否定，避免误译成从不关门。

items.zh: 我不认为他们故意漏掉了你的名字。
items.en: I do not think they omitted your name deliberately.
answers: I do not think they omitted your name deliberately.
I don't think they omitted your name deliberately.
items.notes: 英语常将 think 从句的否定前移至主句。

items.zh: 我想他们不会拒绝合理的延期。
items.en: I do not suppose they will refuse a reasonable extension.
answers: I do not suppose they will refuse a reasonable extension.
I don't suppose they will refuse a reasonable extension.
items.notes: do not suppose 为否定转移，表示推测不太会发生。

items.zh: 我要求的是别打断她，不是让你保持沉默。
items.en: I asked you not to interrupt her, not to remain silent.
answers: I asked you not to interrupt her, not to remain silent.
items.notes: not to interrupt 否定不定式；第二个 not 区分请求范围。

items.zh: 使我生气的不是迟到，而是她没有提前告知。
items.en: What upset me was not her lateness but her failure to let me know.
answers: What upset me was not her lateness but her failure to let me know.
What upset me wasn't her lateness but her failure to let me know.
items.notes: not A but B 清楚界定否定范围，避免 not ... because 的歧义。

items.zh: 他答应免费提供的只有房间，不包括餐食。
items.en: He agreed to provide only the room free of charge, not meals.
answers: He agreed to provide only the room free of charge, not meals.
items.notes: only 靠近 room，限定免费提供的对象。

items.zh: 我没让所有人离开，只请吵闹的人出去。
items.en: I did not ask everyone to leave, only those making noise.
answers: I did not ask everyone to leave, only those making noise.
I didn't ask everyone to leave, only those making noise.
items.notes: not everyone：不是所有人；only 说明实际对象。

items.zh: 不去检查，并不意味着问题不存在。
items.en: Not checking does not mean the problem is absent.
answers: Not checking does not mean the problem is absent.
Not checking doesn't mean the problem is absent.
items.notes: not checking 为否定动名词主语；主句另有否定。

items.zh: 我希望你不要把这次提醒理解为责备。
items.en: I hope you will not take this reminder as blame.
answers: I hope you will not take this reminder as blame.
I hope you won't take this reminder as blame.
items.notes: hope 通常保留从句否定，不用 I do not hope 表同一意思。

items.zh: 她并没有承诺一定会参加。
items.en: She did not promise that she would definitely attend.
answers: She did not promise that she would definitely attend.
She didn't promise that she would definitely attend.
items.notes: 主句否定承诺存在，不等于承诺不参加。

items.zh: 没有要求提交原件，不等于不接受原件。
items.en: Not requiring originals is different from refusing them.
answers: Not requiring originals is different from refusing them.
items.notes: 否定要求与主动拒绝是两个概念；动名词作主语。

items.zh: 你不必买整盒，可以按块购买。
items.en: You need not buy a whole box; individual pieces are available.
answers: You need not buy a whole box; individual pieces are available.
You needn't buy a whole box; individual pieces are available.
items.notes: need not 表不必要，不是禁止。

items.zh: 客人不得把宠物带进备餐区。
items.en: Guests must not bring pets into the food preparation area.
answers: Guests must not bring pets into the food preparation area.
Guests mustn't bring pets into the food preparation area.
items.notes: must not 表禁止，区别 do not have to。

items.zh: 你今天不用付清尾款。
items.en: You do not have to pay the balance today.
answers: You do not have to pay the balance today.
You don't have to pay the balance today.
items.notes: do not have to：无须，并非不能付款。

items.zh: 这条路禁止骑车，但可以推车通过。
items.en: You may not cycle here, but you may walk your bicycle through.
answers: You may not cycle here, but you may walk your bicycle through.
items.notes: may not 在规则语境表不许可；may 表许可。

items.zh: 没有必要为了一页纸重新打印整本册子。
items.en: There is no need to reprint the booklet for a single page.
answers: There is no need to reprint the booklet for a single page.
items.notes: no need to do 表缺乏必要性。

items.zh: 我们不能把别人的联系方式放进公开名单。
items.en: We must not include other people's contact details in the public list.
answers: We must not include other people's contact details in the public list.
We mustn't include other people's contact details in the public list.
items.notes: must not 表明确行为禁令，而非能力不足。

items.zh: 这次不要求穿正式服装。
items.en: Formal clothing is not required on this occasion.
answers: Formal clothing is not required on this occasion.
Formal clothing isn't required on this occasion.
items.notes: not required 表没有义务，不表示 forbidden。

items.zh: 你可以拒绝合照，无须解释原因。
items.en: You may decline the group photograph without having to explain why.
answers: You may decline the group photograph without having to explain why.
items.notes: may 表许可；without having to 表免除义务。

items.zh: 不要使用这台咖啡机，除非工作人员在场。
items.en: You must not use this coffee machine unless a staff member is present.
answers: You must not use this coffee machine unless a staff member is present.
You mustn't use this coffee machine unless a staff member is present.
items.notes: must not ... unless 表带例外条件的禁止。

items.zh: 只要仍有空位，你就不用提前预约。
items.en: You need not reserve a place while spaces remain available.
answers: You need not reserve a place while spaces remain available.
You needn't reserve a place while spaces remain available.
items.notes: need not 表不必要；while 限定适用期间。

items.zh: 最好提前尝一下酱汁，再决定配什么主食。
items.en: You had better taste the sauce before choosing an accompaniment.
answers: You had better taste the sauce before choosing an accompaniment.
items.notes: had better 后接原形，表示较强建议。

items.zh: 我们应该给行动较慢的人留出更多时间。
items.en: We ought to allow extra time for slower walkers.
answers: We ought to allow extra time for slower walkers.
items.notes: ought to do 表应当，保留 to。

items.zh: 不妨先问问主人是否愿意接受帮忙。
items.en: You could ask the host whether help would be welcome.
answers: You could ask the host whether help would be welcome.
items.notes: could 表建议，不是过去能力。

items.zh: 在公开批评之前，你应该先核实引文。
items.en: You should verify the quotation before criticising it publicly.
answers: You should verify the quotation before criticising it publicly.
items.notes: should 表建议义务，强度通常低于 must。

items.zh: 我宁愿现在说明误会，也不愿拖到聚会以后。
items.en: I would rather explain the misunderstanding now than after the gathering.
answers: I would rather explain the misunderstanding now than after the gathering.
items.notes: would rather 后接原形，与 rather than 的结构区分。

items.zh: 你最好不要把鞋放在门口的通道里。
items.en: You had better not leave shoes in the doorway.
answers: You had better not leave shoes in the doorway.
items.notes: had better not + 原形，not 放在 better 后。

items.zh: 如果餐厅已经知道过敏情况，就应该明确标注这份餐点。
items.en: If the restaurant knows about the allergy, it should label the meal clearly.
answers: If the restaurant knows about the allergy, it should label the meal clearly.
items.notes: should 表基于责任的建议，而非结果必然发生。

items.zh: 我们或许可以把发言顺序交给参加者抽签决定。
items.en: We might let participants draw lots for the speaking order.
answers: We might let participants draw lots for the speaking order.
items.notes: might 作试探性建议，保留协商空间。

items.zh: 我宁愿你先征得她同意。
items.en: I would rather you asked for her consent first.
answers: I would rather you asked for her consent first.
items.notes: would rather + 主语 + 过去式，表示希望他人现在或将来做。

items.zh: 你没有义务接受所有人的意见。
items.en: You are under no obligation to accept everyone's advice.
answers: You are under no obligation to accept everyone's advice.
items.notes: under no obligation to：没有义务；advice 不可数。

items.zh: 餐厅可能换过厨师，因为菜的风格很不一样。
items.en: The restaurant may have a different chef, as the food has changed markedly.
answers: The restaurant may have a different chef, as the food has changed markedly.
items.notes: may 表可能；have 在此是实义动词，并非完成结构。

items.zh: 这不可能是我们的账单，我们没有点鱼。
items.en: This cannot be our bill; we ordered no fish.
answers: This cannot be our bill; we ordered no fish.
This can't be our bill; we ordered no fish.
items.notes: cannot be 表基于证据的不可能判断。

items.zh: 那一定是婚礼队伍，我认出了新娘。
items.en: That must be the wedding party; I recognise the bride.
answers: That must be the wedding party; I recognise the bride.
items.notes: must be 表推断，不是义务。

items.zh: 在这个海湾，潮水可能涨得很快。
items.en: The tide can rise quickly in this bay.
answers: The tide can rise quickly in this bay.
items.notes: can 表客观可能性或一般特征，不特指某次推测。

items.zh: 他们也许还在赶来的路上。
items.en: They might still be on their way.
answers: They might still be on their way.
items.notes: might 表较弱推测；on their way：在途中。

items.zh: 看台上很安静，但比赛不一定结束了。
items.en: The stands are quiet, but the match need not be over.
answers: The stands are quiet, but the match need not be over.
The stands are quiet, but the match needn't be over.
items.notes: need not be 表不必然，不是没有义务结束。

items.zh: 没有回应可能只是说明手机不在身边。
items.en: A lack of response may simply mean the phone is out of reach.
answers: A lack of response may simply mean the phone is out of reach.
items.notes: may mean 表可能解释，非断言。

items.zh: 他应该已经知道地点了，因为邀请函写得很清楚。
items.en: He should know the location, since the invitation is clear.
answers: He should know the location, since the invitation is clear.
items.notes: should 表合理预期，不是要求知道。

items.zh: 这可能是正确的门，也可能只是员工入口。
items.en: This could be the right door or merely a staff entrance.
answers: This could be the right door or merely a staff entrance.
items.notes: could 表可能，or 提供另一解释。

items.zh: 只凭这张照片，我们不能确定是谁到场了。
items.en: We cannot determine who attended from this photograph alone.
answers: We cannot determine who attended from this photograph alone.
We can't determine who attended from this photograph alone.
items.notes: cannot 表证据不足导致无法判断，不是禁止判断。

items.zh: 很少有餐厅在清晨供应这道菜。
items.en: Few restaurants serve this dish at dawn.
answers: Few restaurants serve this dish at dawn.
items.notes: few 带近乎否定的数量含义。

items.zh: 我们几乎听不见楼下的音乐。
items.en: We can hardly hear the music downstairs.
answers: We can hardly hear the music downstairs.
items.notes: hardly 自带否定意味，不再加 not。

items.zh: 这不是什么小小的不便，它会影响整段旅程。
items.en: This is no minor inconvenience; it affects the entire journey.
answers: This is no minor inconvenience; it affects the entire journey.
items.notes: no + 名词短语强调否定程度，而非简单无此物。

items.zh: 他几乎从不在没有看过菜单时点菜。
items.en: He hardly ever orders without reading the menu.
answers: He hardly ever orders without reading the menu.
items.notes: hardly ever：几乎从不，不用 hardly never。

items.zh: 只有会员能带一名客人，不是每个人都能带。
items.en: Only members may bring a guest; the permission is not universal.
answers: Only members may bring a guest; the permission is not universal.
Only members may bring a guest; the permission isn't universal.
items.notes: only 限定主体，区别 members may only bring a guest。

items.zh: 我只是借了那本书，没有拿走其他东西。
items.en: I borrowed only the book and took nothing else.
answers: I borrowed only the book and took nothing else.
items.notes: only 紧邻 book 限定宾语范围。

items.zh: 这个结果与失败相去甚远。
items.en: The outcome is far from a failure.
answers: The outcome is far from a failure.
items.notes: far from + 名词表达强烈否定评价。

items.zh: 我们既没有要求折扣，也没有要求特殊座位。
items.en: We requested neither a discount nor special seating.
answers: We requested neither a discount nor special seating.
items.notes: neither ... nor ... 并列两个被否定对象。

items.zh: 我不能不注意到这两份菜单的价格差异。
items.en: I cannot help noticing the price difference between the menus.
answers: I cannot help noticing the price difference between the menus.
I can't help noticing the price difference between the menus.
items.notes: cannot help doing：不由得做，并非不能帮助。

items.zh: 我并不是没有兴趣，只是不能承诺每周参加。
items.en: I am not uninterested; I simply cannot commit to attending every week.
answers: I am not uninterested; I simply cannot commit to attending every week.
I am not uninterested; I simply can't commit to attending every week.
items.notes: not + 否定前缀词缓和否定；不能简单当作热情很高。
